title: Counterfactual Feature Regularization for Expansion-Based Class-Incremental Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.09145v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Current expansion-based methods for Class Incremental Learning (CIL) effectively mitigate catastrophic forgetting by freezing old features. However, such task-specific features learned from the new task may collide with the old features. From a causal perspective, spurious feature correlations are the main cause of this collision, manifesting in two scopes: (i) guided by empirical risk minimization (ERM), intra-task spurious correlations cause task-specific features to rely on shortcut features. These non-robust features are vulnerable to interference, inevitably drifting into the feature space of other tasks; (ii) inter-task spurious correlations induce semantic confusion between visually similar classes across tasks. To address this, we propose a Probability of Necessity and Sufficiency (PNS)-based regularization method to guide feature expansion in CIL. translated_title: 面向基于扩展的类增量学习的反事实特征正则化
translated_abstract: 当前基于扩展的类增量学习方法通过冻结旧特征有效缓解了灾难性遗忘问题。然而，从新任务中学习到的任务特定特征可能与旧特征发生冲突。从因果视角来看，虚假特征相关性是导致这种冲突的主要原因，其表现在两个方面：（i）在经验风险最小化（ERM）的引导下，任务内虚假相关性使任务特定特征依赖于捷径特征，这些非鲁棒特征容易受到干扰，不可避免地漂移到其他任务的特征空间中；（ii）任务间虚假相关性会在跨任务的视觉相似类别之间引发语义混淆。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于必要性与充分性概率（PNS）的正则化方法，用于指导类增量学习中的特征扩展。具体而言，我们首先将PNS的定义扩展到基于扩展的类增量学习中……
tldr: 本文从因果视角指出虚假特征相关性是新旧特征冲突的根源，提出基于必要性与充分性概率（PNS）的反事实特征正则化方法，以消除任务内和任务间的虚假相关性，指导类增量学习中的特征扩展。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies spurious feature correlations as the root cause of collisions between old and new features in expansion-based class-incremental learning, and proposes a counterfactual feature regularization method based on Probability of Necessity and Sufficiency (PNS) to eliminate intra-task and inter-task spurious correlations and guide feature expansion.
